sloka: ततः संसक्तहस्तस्तु रावणो लोकरावणः।नाराचमालां रामस्य ललाटे प्रत्यमुञ्चत ।। ६.१००.३४ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṁsaktahastastu rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ।nārācamālāṁ rāmasya lalāṭe pratyamuñcata ।। 6.100.34 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana, who made the people cry, whose hands were engaged in the fight, discharged a row of steel arrows into Rama's forehead.
